environment.build: debug native + React profiling production browser

coverage.readBytes: application returned bytes: metadata,usage,index,links; excludes directory/stat/fingerprint, SQLite, network and other reads
coverage.mutationSemantics: committed SQLite row callbacks only; FTS shadow rows are implementation rows; WITHOUT ROWID and unscoped writes unknown
coverage.waitSemantics: BEGIN admission; deferred queue hold includes later writer upgrade contention; immediate corpus wait precedes hold
coverage.walSemantics: sampled retained file length, never cumulative writes
coverage.memorySemantics: native RSS and Chromium renderer JS heap include telemetry; application-only/browser-process/WebKit heap unknown

sampleDesign: 5 cold + 5 warm; maximum with engineering headroom, no p95 claim
headroom: 2 * observed maximum + 1 MiB for sizes, + 1 ms for transaction timing, + 500 ms command latency; scoped transaction/callback counts: 2 * observed maximum + 1 occurrence, but observed-zero remains zero; unknown tables reject
